body.label: Target
body.html: An area or group within weapon range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose up to three creatures within 2 units of one another and within weapon range. Compare this Action against each. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage.

surges.html: Choose one creature this Action succeeds against. After this resolves, you may make a Basic Shot against it by committing that Basic Shot's dice normally.
If another creature or object lies directly between you and the target, the Action may affect both using the same roll.

rider.title: SALVO
rider.html: If your Locked target is among the targets, gain 1 free Surge that may only be spent on a Cadence or Payload Surge.
